headline: Nvidia boosts share buyback authorization by $150 billion, total program now $235 billion

supports: On September 28, 2026, Nvidia announced a $150 billion increase to its share repurchase authorization.
After the increase, Nvidia's total remaining share repurchase authorization stands at $235 billion.

caption:
🇺🇸 Nvidia announced on Sept. 28 a $150 billion increase to its share repurchase authorization, bringing the company's total remaining buyback program to $235 billion. CEO Jensen Huang said the move reflects Nvidia's cash-generation strength, giving it room to keep investing in AI technology while returning capital to shareholders.

🇪🇸 Nvidia anunció el 28 de septiembre un aumento de 150,000 millones de dólares en su autorización de recompra de acciones, elevando el programa total restante a 235,000 millones de dólares. El CEO Jensen Huang dijo que la medida refleja la solidez de generación de efectivo de la empresa, que le permite seguir invirtiendo en tecnología de IA mientras retorna capital a los accionistas.

Sources: NVIDIA Newsroom / Yahoo Finance — Sept. 28, 2026.
